items.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
items.summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims' claims to the coins.

items.title: Bitcoin-Rallye scheitert über Nacht: Warum die Märkte wieder fallen
items.summary: Zwischen 85.000 und 87.500 US-Dollar warten viele Bitcoin-Anleger nur darauf, ohne Verlust auszusteigen. Kann der Kurs diese Hürde nehmen? Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
items.summary: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

items.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
items.summary: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.
